SELECT ls.id AS sessionId, lr.anchor_avatar AS anchorAvatar, lr.anchor_name AS anchorName, ls.start_time AS startTime, ls.duration AS duration, sp.quantity AS quantity, sp.sales_amount AS salesAmount, sp.refund_amount AS refundAmount, ls.view_count AS viewCount FROM session_product sp INNER JOIN live_session ls ON sp.session_id = ls.id AND ls.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN live_room lr ON ls.live_room_id = lr.id AND lr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sp.product_id = #{productId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(ls.start_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY
start_time duration quantity sales_amount view_count start_time
ASC DESC DESC

SELECT sp.company_id AS companyId, sc.name AS companyName, SUM(sp.quantity) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sp.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, SUM(ls.view_count) AS viewCount FROM session_product sp INNER JOIN live_session ls ON sp.session_id = ls.id AND ls.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sub_company sc ON sp.company_id = sc.id AND sc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sp.product_id = #{productId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(ls.start_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY sp.company_id, sc.name ORDER BY
sales_amount quantity view_count sales_amount
ASC DESC DESC
